BODY: Roger said go. Save the file below as .github/workflows/fix-gumroad-links.yml in BOTH Keywebco/nextxus-unified-storefront and Keywebco/nextxus-truth-gate-core, push each. Then confirm here. Roger will tap Run workflow on his phone in each repo; the workflow seds rogerkey->keywebster in-repo and pushes itself. FILE:
name: Zap - fix dead Gumroad links (rogerkey to keywebster)

# One-tap fix: Roger opens this repo on github.com -> Actions ->
# "Zap - fix dead Gumroad links" -> Run workflow. No keyboard needed.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  fix-links:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Replace dead rogerkey.gumroad.com links
        run: |
          grep -rl "rogerkey.gumroad.com" --include="*.html" . | xargs sed -i 's/rogerkey\.gumroad\.com/keywebster.gumroad.com/g' || true
          echo "--- remaining rogerkey refs (want none) ---"
          grep -rn "rogerkey.gumroad.com" --include="*.html" . || echo "clean"

      - name: Commit and push if changed
        run: |
          git config user.name "federation-zap"
          git config user.email "stewardship@nextxus.online"
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --quiet && echo "nothing to fix" || git commit -m "Zap: rogerkey.gumroad.com -> keywebster.gumroad.com (dead 404 links)"
          git push
